definitions.explanation: An official or formal announcement of a position or intention.

examples.japanese: {政府|せいふ}が{声明|せいめい}を{発表|はっぴょう}した。
{共同|きょうどう}{声明|せいめい}に{署名|しょめい}した。
{社長|しゃちょう}が{記者会見|きしゃかいけん}で{声明|せいめい}を{読|よ}み{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: The president read out a statement at the press conference.

notes:
Used for official, formal statements typically by governments, organizations, or public figures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{声明|せいめい}を{発表|はっぴょう}する (to issue a statement)
・{声明|せいめい}を{出|だ}す (to put out a statement)
・{共同|きょうどう}{声明|せいめい} (joint statement)
・{公式|こうしき}{声明|せいめい} (official statement)
・{声明|せいめい}{文|ぶん} (text of a statement)

HOMOPHONE:
・{姓名|せいめい} - full name (surname + given name)
・{生命|せいめい} - life (biological)

These three words are all read せいめい but have completely different meanings.
